top_choice_rationale: P002 is an original prediction-then-measurement chain: Kane and Mele's time-reversal-invariant Z2 class (2005) and Molenkamp's HgTe edge-conductance observation (2007), later reproduced in other systems. It is a distinct symmetry class from the 2016 quantum Hall/Haldane prize, and the narrow citation avoids claiming the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang platform proposal, 3D materials or the quantum anomalous Hall effect. P001 is a close second with a cleaner two-name credit, but the magic-wavelength lattice clock sits nearer the earlier comb and ion-clock prizes, and I would want primary papers to confirm Katori's priority before ranking it first. Any award is preferred to no award given the maturity of both.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague, but no joint work with the credited names or topics
